evidence.quote: To improve the program’s efficiency, we selected only sources for which at least one of the two cataloged photometric redshift estimates (optical/near-IR-based, or far-IR based) is within $|\Delta z| < 2 \sigma \approx 0.76$ of Antu.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Spuriously enhanced IGM absorption in IGM-A; judged unlikely because absorption is spread over many sight lines and insensitive to removing individual sight lines

evidence.quote: We also considered the possibility that the IGM absorption in IGM-A is spuriously enhanced, such that the matter and the expected galaxy overdensities are simply overestimated.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: High column density absorbers as the origin of outliers; statistically argued not to explain all outliers

evidence.loc: 4 The LBG Content of IGM-selected Overdensities
evidence.quote: we find that it cannot readily explain the outlier population either

how_they_decided_enough.value: Integration times set to give a 5.2 sigma line detection for 90% of sources

evidence.loc: 5.4 An ALMA Search for Dusty Star-forming Members
evidence.quote: Target sensitivities were designed to produce a $5.2 \sigma$ line detection for 90% of sources, as estimated from their 850 $\mu$m flux densities.

limitations_admitted.value: ALMA coverage is a subregion near IGM-A and does not cover the full extent of Antu

evidence.loc: 5.4 An ALMA Search for Dusty Star-forming Members
evidence.quote: The ALMA observations do not cover the full extent of Antu, but rather target a subregion within $\simeq 8$ arcmin ($\simeq 10$ $h^{-1}$ cMpc) of IGM-A.

limitations_admitted.value: Submillimeter selection probes galaxies about 10x more massive than the LBG-mass galaxies that are missing, so lower-mass dusty galaxies remain possible

evidence.quote: Lower-mass dusty galaxies thus remain a candidate

limitations_admitted.value: IGM-A being a real overdensity cannot be confirmed until a coincident galaxy overdensity is found

evidence.quote: Until we find a commensurate and coincident galaxy overdensity, this will remain a possibility.

referee_caveats_inferred: ALMA depth is shallow (4-16 min per source) and is tuned to a conservative L_IR-derived CO flux, so non-detections constrain only bright CO emitters
Only 38 pre-selected submm sources were observed; fainter or lower-mass dusty members would be missed
No upper limits on CO flux or L_IR are reported for the non-detections
ALMA array, calibration and imaging details are absent, so the ALMA result cannot be independently re-derived from the paper alone
Main results rely on the unreleased LATIS data and mocks described in N25

missing_for_reproduction: LATIS IGM maps, LBG maps and mock surveys (described in N25, not in this paper)
ALMA array, calibration, imaging and cube-making details for project 2021.1.01005.S
Target list with IDs and coordinates
Polynomial order and noise normalisation for the SNR cubes
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Moderate (tens of GB): 38 short Band 3 pointings for one ALMA project; the LATIS and Magellan data are not on ALMA archive.
reproducibility.score_reason: The ALMA part is a brief non-detection search with sparse settings, and the main results rely on LATIS maps, mocks and Magellan data that are not public or fully described in this paper.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ALMA plays a minor role, the recipe is incomplete, and the key results depend on non-public LATIS data and companion-paper products.

methods_papers.why: LATIS survey design, spectroscopy and LBG selection
LATIS galaxy clustering and halo mass for the mock galaxy model
super-deblended catalog for ALMA target coordinates and redshifts
SCUBA-2 COSMOS 850 um catalog used for target selection

companion_papers.why: catalog of 37 protogroups and protoclusters from LATIS IGM maps; full description of data and mocks
earlier LATIS analysis of UV-dim protoclusters, revised here
